prompt_templates.title: Red noir prophecy

prompt_templates.title: Glitch throne

prompt_templates.title: Echo shoal

prompt_templates.title: Chart of the deep

prompt_templates.body: Hard red flash to black, then the Deepotus mark fades in at center, single sonar ping, sub-second, punchy social opener.
